model.title: Enhancing Geothermal Production on Federal Lands Act
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Russ Fulcher (R-ID)

summary.text: The bill would exempt certain geothermal exploration projects on federal land from the environmental review required by the National Environmental Policy Act. These are projects that drill exploratory wells, such as temperature gradient, monitoring, or calibration wells, and that stay within set limits on size, duration, and other aspects. The bill would also exempt related activities from that review, including geotechnical investigations, off-road travel in certain existing rights-of-way, and building, maintaining, realigning, and repairing access roads within those rights-of-way.
